name: lao-typography
description: Lao (ພາສາລາວ) language, typography and font design for professional work: translation, proofreading and typesetting with Noto Sans Lao by default, Unicode and font fixes, OCR, spoken and written voice, web and graphic design, alphabet teaching, a Lao text checker, and a font studio that builds working TTF/WOFF2 fonts from a prompt.

interface.longDescription: Professional Lao (ພາສາລາວ) work in one plugin. Translate between Lao and English; proofread and typeset Lao in Word, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF and web pages with Noto Sans Lao by default; fix boxes, floating tone marks, Thai letters mixed into Lao, and legacy fonts; read Lao from images; prepare voiceover scripts and subtitles; design posters and brands with live Lao text; teach the alphabet; and build new Lao fonts from a prompt. Includes a checker that finds common Lao text errors in files, and tested recipes for every common format.
defaultPrompt: Translate this English text into natural Lao
Make a Lao price list as a Word file and a PDF
Design a Lao headline font for a festival poster
